Secondary batteries · Commercial

Lithium titanate · LTO

Uses an LTO anode instead of conventional graphite. Structural changes during cycling are small.

Animated operating principles

Ion and electron pathways

Li⁺ · electrolyte / membrane Electrons e⁻ · external circuit

Simplified reaction directions and pathways. Actual particle numbers and speeds differ.

Electrode and electrolyte principles

Organic electrolyte with lithium salts

Discharge: lithiated LTO → LTO + Li⁺ + e⁻ / cathode accepts Li⁺ and e⁻

Advantages

Strengths in fast charging, long life and low-temperature power.

Drawbacks & challenges

Low cell voltage and energy density add weight, volume and cost burdens.

Materials & supply constraints

Titanium and lithium; nickel/cobalt may be used depending on cathode

Main applications

Fast-charging buses, industrial equipment and UPS
